{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Zora Sword Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Zora Sword Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Zora Sword Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Zora Sword Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Attacking Enemies |strength= 15 |durability= 27 |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Zora Swords''' are recurring [[Items]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Zora Sword|Zora Swords|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 15 |durability = 27 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Zora Sword}} Zora Swords are one-handed [[Weapon]]s fashioned by the [[Zora]]. These Swords belong to the [[Zora Gear]] equipment archetype. They are forged from a type of durable and rust-resistant metal and ornamented with traditional Zora designs. The metal they are constructed from is known to be durable and rust-proof. They are commonly found within [[East Necluda]] and the [[Lanayru Great Spring]], particularly in and around [[Zora's Domain]]. Zora Swords are made of metal, and therefore they do not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They do, however, conduct [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they also conduct [[Electricity]]. If they are dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], they will sink, but they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_027" |Life = 27 |Power = 15 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 14 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 18 |BuyingPrice = 70 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Zora Sword}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link One-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where the Item is found * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} An ancient version of the Zora Sword appears in {{AoI}}, which is wielded by [[Zora Soldier]]s.
